data.title: Stabilize fold-chain performance gate
data.description: For bn-2nd: replace the load-sensitive normal-suite wall-clock assertion with exact deterministic fold-chain construction coverage; retain performance admission as an explicit ignored release-mode quiet-host median gate; document 3/3 contended pre failures, 3/3 post passes, and 171.6 ns/event post measurement. Commit 23049f2. Please verify that correctness/performance coverage is not weakened and the quiet-host gate remains reproducible.

data.reason: Approved static review. The normal suite now exercises only byte-exact deterministic construction/composition across boundary payload/version cases; the sole Instant-based test is unconditionally ignored and asserts release mode when explicitly invoked. The explicit gate is reproducible and materially bounded: fixed 250-byte payload, 10k warmup, five paired 1M-event samples, median selection, 510 ns/event ceiling tied to the documented 169.3 ns/event reference, plus chain-step < frame-hash sanity. The report records the contended pre failures, 3/3 deterministic passes, 171.6 ns/event gate result, host/toolchain, and exact commands. No build was run because the quiet host is reserved.
